# Southern Living

> > Southern Living is the definitive guide to Southern culture, featuring reader-voted awards, regional recipes, home maintenance advice, and lifestyle content celebrating the American South.

Southern Living showcases the best of Southern destinations, restaurants, and traditions through reader engagement and expert guidance. The site covers everything from classic Southern recipes and grilling techniques to home care tips, gardening advice, and regional travel destinations across states like North Carolina, South Carolina, Florida, and Georgia.

## Key Topics

- Southern cuisine and recipes
- The South's Best Awards
- Classic Southern restaurants
- Home maintenance and cleaning
- Gardening and rose care
- Regional destinations (North Carolina, South Carolina, Florida, Savannah)
- Grilling and barbecue
- Southern culture and sayings
- Desserts and baking
- 5-star reader-reviewed recipes
- Home organization and decluttering
- Seasonal cooking and farmers' markets
- Southern hospitality and entertaining

## The South's Best Awards & Destinations

- [The South's Best of 2026](https://www.southernliving.com/souths-best): Reader-voted awards for best Southern destinations, restaurants, and resorts
- [The South's Best Classic Restaurants 2026](https://www.southernliving.com/best-classic-restaurants-2026-11903185): Reader-voted rankings of the South's best locally-owned classic restaurants
- [This Raw Bar On Florida's Forgotten Coast Is A Hidden Gem](https://www.southernliving.com/indian-pass-raw-bar-11916788): Profile of Indian Pass Raw Bar in Port St. Joe with honor system oysters
